purpose: Verbindlicher Design- und Runtimevertrag fuer die aktive Statuswert-Migration.

calibration_point.principle: Bisherige Referenzwirkungen werden bei Status 75 ungefaehr erhalten; niedrigere und hoehere Statuswerte unterscheiden die Wirkungsstaerke weich.

leech_seed.damage: fixed 1/8 target max HP per tick

electric_terrain.keep_binary: prevent new sleep on grounded Pokemon

grassy_glide.condition: successful hit while user is grounded and grassy terrain is active

volt_switch.keep_fixed: self aggro multiplier 0.55 after successful hit

dragon_cheer.stacking: no stack/refresh with Dragon Cheer or Focus Energy

explicit_non_migrations.rest: Fixed full heal remains a tradeoff mechanic because it forces sleep.
explicit_non_migrations.pain_split: HP averaging is a rule operation, not normal healing.
explicit_non_migrations.night_shade: Fixed damage equal to user level.
explicit_non_migrations.super_fang: Fixed fraction of current target HP.
explicit_non_migrations.fire_spin: Central binding rule remains fixed; periodic damage is not Status-scaled.
explicit_non_migrations.sand_tomb: Central binding rule remains fixed; periodic damage is not Status-scaled.
explicit_non_migrations.whirlpool: Central binding rule remains fixed; periodic damage is not Status-scaled.
explicit_non_migrations.wrap: Central binding rule remains fixed; periodic damage is not Status-scaled.
explicit_non_migrations.fire_pledge: Central team-combo field rule remains fixed.
explicit_non_migrations.grass_pledge: Central team-combo field rule remains fixed.
explicit_non_migrations.water_pledge: Central team-combo field rule remains fixed.
